title: Tom DeLonge books on official and non-government programs

tellings.quote: you read the Tom Deong books, he sort of points to this idea of there essentially being, you know, official government programs and then non-government programs.

plain: Secret UFO work may be split between official government programmes and programmes run outside government. A guest named Matthew Pines says this idea runs through the books of Tom DeLonge, a man who has written on the subject, saying that DeLonge "sort of points to" both kinds. If so, some of the secret work would sit beyond the government's own oversight.
